facts.value: Students enrolled in other departments can complete certain modules in the Department of Economics, known as export modules, including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For the study programs of other departments, there is an overview detailing which export modules can be registered at the Department of Economics and how these modules can be integrated into the studies of the other department.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: No other modules from the Department of Economics can be integrated into the studies of the other department, and no differing Credit Points (CP) can be earned at the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance
